about.heading: Building Better
about.description: DevOps Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with 4 years of experience delivering secure, automated, cloud-native platforms on AWS.
paragraphs: I am a DevOps Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with 4 years of hands-on experience delivering secure, automated, cloud-native platforms on AWS and full-stack web applications.

I build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Git, provision repeatable infrastructure with Terraform (cutting client setup time by 80%), run containerized microservices on Docker and Kubernetes, enforce quality gates with SonarQube, and monitor production systems with Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch.

On the application side, I develop end-to-end systems using Python, PHP, Node.js, React.js, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, and leverage AI-assisted development and LLM integration (RAG agents, Gemini API, OpenAI API) to ship high-accuracy products rapidly.

projects.title: AI RAG Chatbot, CRM Portal & WordPress Guide Platform
projects.description: Created a single-page AI RAG chatbot where users supply documents, files, and URLs for context-aware answers, integrated with a full-stack CRM portal and a custom WordPress guide platform.
projects.deepDive: Architected the full system independently (frontend, APIs, database, LLM integration) covering document/URL ingestion, semantic retrieval, and conversation memory, and managed hosting and deployment on AWS using DevOps practices.
highlights: Created a single-page AI chatbot where users supply documents, files, and URLs that a RAG agent uses for context-aware answers, covering ingestion, retrieval, and conversation memory.
Architected the full system independently (frontend, APIs, database, LLM integration) and managed hosting and deployment on AWS and open platforms using DevOps practices.
Engineered a CRM portal with lead and customer record management and an admin dashboard for managing users and data, integrated with the RAG chatbot for AI-assisted customer interactions.

Designed and created a WordPress guide platform as the sole developer, implementing a notification system, custom taxonomies, client profiles, a news section, interactive tools, and reusable UI components.
projects.impact: Full-stack RAG agent, CRM portal & custom guide platform architected end-to-end.
